title: Jewel Toned Molten Filipino Kabocha Casserole
description: A pungent and comforting Filipino dish featuring kabocha, this lacto-vegetarian friendly casserole is perfect for a cold winter night, the terracotta dish adding an earthy touch to the presentation.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat the oil over medium heat and saute the onion until translucent.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pan and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cubed kabocha to the pan and cook for 5 minutes, until slightly tender.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked kabocha mixture, coconut milk, salt, and pepper, and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a terracotta dish and top with shredded cheese.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the casserole from the oven and sprinkle with chopped cilantro, if desired.
Let the casserole cool for a few minutes before serving.
